headline: US Dollar Reaches Highs Amid Muted Treasury Yield Movements
summary: The US dollar index climbed to its highest level since April while US Treasury yields recorded minor fluctuations as currency traders monitored trade and monetary developments.
why: The US dollar serves as the primary global reserve currency and influences global trade, commodity pricing, and capital flows.

impacts.name: US Dollar
impacts.why: Safe-haven flows and changing monetary expectations boosted dollar demand against major peers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Global equity weakness drove demand into cash assets denominated in US dollars.
